name: bmc-toolkit
description: Skills for BMC firmware developers: answer questions from the BMC specification corpus (IPMI, DMTF MCTP/PLDM/SPDM, Redfish, NVMe-MI, OCP, ...) and from OpenBMC, Aspeed and Nuvoton source, with citations; write ipmitool raw, pldmtool and mctp-client lines for a named command and explain pasted responses.
